# Qala Labs

> Qala Labs is an AI and growth studio with teams in Delhi NCR and London. We build the revenue system brands run on: performance marketing, AI agents and automation, search visibility (SEO, AEO, GEO), custom software, and creative production.

Qala Labs is a studio, not a single-service agency. Work is proven in public: every case study below lists the numbers, the approach and what was measured. Contact: hello@qalalabs.com

## Services

- [AI Automation](https://qalalabs.com/services/ai-automation): Multi-agent systems for finance, CRM, inventory, logistics, support and voice.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://qalalabs.com/services/ai-voice-agents): 24/7 voice agents that answer, qualify and route calls.
- [Digital Marketing](https://qalalabs.com/services/digital-marketing): Performance marketing across Meta, Google and Amazon.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://qalalabs.com/services/search-engine-optimization): SEO, AEO (answer engines) and GEO (generative engines).
- [Social Media Marketing](https://qalalabs.com/services/social-media-marketing): Organic community and creator programmes plus paid social.
- [Branding](https://qalalabs.com/services/branding)
- [UI/UX Design](https://qalalabs.com/services/ui-ux-design)
- [Web Design](https://qalalabs.com/services/web-design)
- [Mobile App Designing](https://qalalabs.com/services/mobile-app-designing)
- [Landing Page Designing](https://qalalabs.com/services/landing-page-designing)
- [Web Development](https://qalalabs.com/services/web-development)
- [Mobile App Development](https://qalalabs.com/services/mobile-app-development)
- [Software Development](https://qalalabs.com/services/software-development)

## Products

- [MarksOps](https://qalalabs.com/products/marksops): Multi-agent operations platform unifying marketing, sales, operations and finance.

- [AI Receptionist](https://qalalabs.com/products/ai-receptionist)

## Case studies

- [Trotr: Spain Pivot](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/trotr-spain-pivot): 28x ROAS and Rs 14L revenue from a high-ticket travel funnel.
- [Amazon Ads Scaling](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/amazon-ads-scaling): 11.2x ROAS and 47% lower ACOS.
- [Nutrivend UK](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/nutrivend-uk): 45 qualified B2B leads and 71% untapped market discovered.
- [The Kashmiri Sound Movement](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/kashmiri-sound-movement): 3.4M+ organic views with zero ad spend.
- [Airborne Aviation: SEO, AEO & GEO](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/airborne-aviation-seo-aeo-geo): 26.3K impressions and 484 clicks in 12 weeks, with open problems stated.
- [Gaffar India](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/gaffar-india): Market stall to digital multi-vendor marketplace.
- [Capital Keys](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/capital-keys): Real estate proptech platform and CRM engine.
- [Mizuno India](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/mizuno-india-launch): Commercial production shoot and 10-week pre-launch runway.
- [Nectar Loyalty Engine](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/nectar-loyalty-engine): Dual-currency loyalty architecture on Google Cloud Run.
